title: corydalis capillaris
intro: Corydalis capillaris, commonly known as Yan Hu Suo or Chinese Corydalis, is a plant native to East Asia that has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain, particularly in cases of arthritis and fibromyalgia. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis capillaris are attributed to its sedative and analgesic properties, which work to calm the nervous system and relieve discomfort. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids such as dehydrocorybulbine and tetrahydroprotoberberine, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
